snippet.title: Mario Superstar Baseball - Opening Cinematic
snippet.description:
This video shows what happens when you let the opening scene run for Mario Superstar Baseball on Nintendo Gamecube.

This channel features various educational, instructional and entertaining videogame videos, with a focus on Mario Party, Mario Maker, Luigi's Mansion and many other Nintendo games.  My own personal gameplay, creative input and editing is clearly added into each video assuring that all videos to adhere to YouTube's partner program guidelines. Every video is my own unique creation and each video is recorded and edited by me. Permission to upload all my unique gameplay on this channel was given by Nintendo.
